You can just slide brightness up or down, and the flickering seems to stop. It's irritating to have to stop what you are doing, but the product is so far fixable so I'm living with it.

Has the screen flicker flaw. I previously had a Pixel and loved it. Apparently, this was a common LG manufacturer problem with this model. Unfortunately, I paid import taxes on this phone and everything else seems fine, so I am reluctant to return it. My loss. I wish I had looked at more negative reviews of the 3, rather than just focusing on features, before purchase. Update: Less than a month after purchase, the screen flashing became permanent. Renewed Google Pixel 3. I was very impressed with the condition of the Pixel 3. It looked brand new! The screen clarity is very good as well as the camera. After 7 hours I still had 65% left on the battery life. It is a great buy and it came within 2 days instead of the 8 days I was told when I ordered it. I have never bought a used phone before and I was very reluctant to make the purchase. Like new, as advertised - but experiencing problems 5 months in. I ordered the pixel 5 inch and it arrived in truly "like new" condition as the seller promised. There were some tiny (nearly invisible) scratches on the mirrored black part on the top third of the back of the phone, but really nothing to quibble about. I was very relieved about that. Plus it was 2/3rds of the price of a new one, so well worth it in my opinion. I've had it over a month and am very pleased with it. I do notice that when I run, say, Google Maps, open on-screen for an hour while navigating in 70+ degree whether, the battery gets noticeably hot. But not enough to overly concern me (although it does worry me a little). The battery life isn't quite what I expected - by the end of the day it's generally down to 20% or lower, which I'm not used to.
